referenceFunction.generalComment: The data represent a mixture (50:50) of metallic and metal-free glasfibre cable for the transfer of data. Material data are taken from datasheet of a producer of such cables. Infrastructure and production efforts are based on own assumptions. The dataset is an average of cables with a meter-weight of 0.03 resp. 0.079 kg/m. In 2023 updates, material and energy input are now represented by global inventory flows; Geography: Data from one Swiss producer, used as representative for the global situation.; UUID: 65aec195-832d-3b1b-8d8d-0bcac2160392
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes material, an estimation of the production efforts (transportation, energy, process chemicals, …) and of the infrastructure for the production of a three-conductor cable used in the construction of new buildings. No information about emissions (air, water) and waste are included.
